# Vendored ccxt for mobile packaging

- **`vendor/ccxt/`** — generated by `python scripts/vendor_ccxt_mobile.py` (gitignored).
  Wired through `[tool.flet.dev_packages]` so Flet installs via absolute `file:///…`.
- **`vendor/wheels/*.whl`** — optional rewritten wheel kept in git as offline fallback.

Codemagic runs the vendor script before `flet build`. Do **not** depend on
`ccxt @ file:./vendor/wheels/...` (relative paths break in serious_python temp dirs).
